kypExtensions.summary: Reading each CD code as the chapter's machinery with a serial number (CD3 = TCR ignition, CD28 = signal-2 port, CD40L-CD40 = handshake, CD16 = ADCC port, CD14 = LPS sensor) and as a drug/assay handle (anti-CD3, rituximab anti-CD20, basiliximab anti-CD25, alemtuzumab anti-CD52; flow-cytometry panels; HIV CXCR4/CCR5 entry and CCR5-Δ32/maraviroc).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source lists markers without the machinery linkage, the drug map, the flow-reading skill, or HIV coreceptor pharmacology; these integrations are KYP's design, labeled as extension (drug names, Δ32, maraviroc are beyond this printed page).
